title: Clarify selection criteria for Phase 2 and Phase 3 deployments
requirements:
- Give criteria for selecting the first systems to connect so the demonstration is representative
- Present listed business-service components as examples tied to national priorities
- Include accessibility, language, assisted access, non-digital fallback and non-state providers in geographic expansion
- Distinguish disposable pilots from production-oriented pilots
- Require readiness criteria (data quality, governed models, oversight) before advanced decision support or analytics
